own_stay.opening: Hi, I’m enquiring from your Pearl Residences ad. I’m looking for a place for my own stay. Could you share more details?

private_persona.household: Single professional currently renting near Seberang Jaya; wants to move closer to family.
private_persona.financing: Needs a mortgage; has savings for a modest down payment but is wary of stretching.
concerns: whether the advertised price excludes meaningful extra costs
wants to understand nearby amenities and transport
private_persona.patience: Two follow-up utterances after opening; will engage if answers are specific, but will not accept pressure or book a viewing before basic price and timeline clarity.
private_persona.likely_conclusion: May agree to a viewing or a concrete next step if affordability is plausible and key costs/timing are explained.

couple_home_office.opening: Hi, my partner and I saw your Pearl Residences ad. We’re looking for a home with space for a home office. Could you tell me more?

private_persona.household: Couple expecting to work from home several days a week; both need quiet work space, but can share a room if layout permits.
private_persona.financing: Joint mortgage; one partner has variable income and they want to keep monthly commitments conservative.
priorities: reasonable access to jobs and daily needs
concerns: whether a 3-bedroom layout can genuinely fit a work area
fees and furnishing costs beyond headline price
private_persona.patience: Two follow-up utterances after opening; asks practical questions and needs both partners to be comfortable before committing.
private_persona.likely_conclusion: Will consider a viewing if the agent explains the floor plan/space use and gives clear pricing and schedule information; no immediate reservation.

investment.opening: Hi, I saw your Pearl Residences ad and am considering it as an investment. Could you share more details?

private_persona.household: Small private investor comparing Penang residential options; already owns one rental unit elsewhere.
private_persona.financing: Could use a mortgage but expects the rental yield to justify the commitment; does not want to rely on speculative appreciation.
priorities: resale or rental prospects around Seberang Jaya
concerns: completion is years away and rent cannot start until handover
no unsupported yield or capital-growth promises
maintenance charges and actual rental comparables
private_persona.patience: Two follow-up utterances after opening; responds to evidence and numbers, challenges vague claims, and will not book just to be polite.
private_persona.likely_conclusion: May agree to review a priced unit or attend a viewing if total cost and investment assumptions are transparent; otherwise requests evidence and pauses.
